name: taskmgmt
description: Full-stack task management application with authentication, Kanban workflows, and due-task notifications.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run start:frontend" "npm run start:server"
